import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the dataset for better visualization
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Create a joint plot with scatter plot for individual variables and regression line
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.jointplot(x='value', y='sepal_length', data=melted_data[melted_data['variable'] == 'sepal_width'], kind='reg')
sns.jointplot(x='value', y='sepal_length', data=melted_data[melted_data['variable'] == 'petal_length'], kind='reg')
sns.jointplot(x='value', y='sepal_length', data=melted_data[melted_data['variable'] == 'petal_width'], kind='reg')
plt.suptitle('Relationship between Sepal Length and Other Variables')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
